# Bundled third-party files

| File | Project | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vendor/marked.umd.js` | [marked](https://github.com/markedjs/marked) | 18.1.3 | MIT |
| `vendor/purify.min.js` | [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) | 3.4.17 | MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0 |
| `vendor/highlight.min.js` | [highlight.js](https://github.com/highlightjs/highlight.js) | 11.12.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
| `fonts/inter-*.woff2` | [Inter](https://github.com/rsms/inter) via Fontsource | 5.3.0 | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
